scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to paraphrase or restate the customer's issue or situation throughout the call. Sarah moved directly from security verification into sending a PIN reset without offering a reflective paraphrasing statement.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe effectively into the customer's device environment. Sarah never asked for the specific Samsung model, the Android OS version, or whether mobile data was enabled (which is mandatory for OMTP visual voicemail handshake synchronization), jumping straight to clearing app storage data.

grader.scenario: Voicemail pin reset and visual voicemail setup on Android handset
grader.notes: Mobile support call by Sarah resetting a forgotten voicemail PIN and provisioning visual voicemail on a Samsung smartphone. Sarah successfully generates a temporary PIN via SMS and activates the OMTP network token during an announced 45s hold. However, Sarah completely fails Paraphrasing by never restating the customer's request, and fails Probing by never inquiring about device model, OS version, or mobile data connectivity.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: 45s OMTP provisioning hold was announced ('bear with me while I place you on a brief hold') and thanked upon return ('Thank you for your patience while holding').
